$comment: Type-check only (npm run typecheck -> tsc -p tsconfig.json). Source is src/**/*.ts; the shipped lib/ and root client.js are gitignored build artifacts produced by tsdown (npm run build) — never committed, never hand-edited (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). checkJs:false means a .js/.mjs input is checked only where a top-level '// @ts-check' opts it in (test/, tsdown.config.mjs); outside this scope such a pragma is inert, so add it when adding a JS helper that should be checked. The .ts sources are always checked. Start with strict:false; raise per-module as the backlog clears.
